name: roost-teaser
description: Remotion source for assets/roost-teaser.{mp4,gif}. `npm ci && npm run render` writes both into out/.

scripts.render: npm run render:mp4 && npm run render:gif
scripts.render:mp4: remotion render src/index.ts RoostTeaser out/roost-teaser.raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --image-format=png --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --crf=18 --muted && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/roost-teaser.raw.mp4 -c copy -movflags +faststart out/roost-teaser.mp4 && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out/roost-teaser.raw.mp4')"
scripts.render:gif: ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/roost-teaser.mp4 -vf fps=15,scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,palettegen=max_colors=128:stats_mode=diff out/roost-teaser.palette.png && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/roost-teaser.mp4 -i out/roost-teaser.palette.png -lavfi "fps=15,scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos[x];[x][1:v]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5:diff_mode=rectangle" -loop 0 out/roost-teaser.gif && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out/roost-teaser.palette.png')"
